sense: of plants and fruit: growing without care

evidence: Ov. M. 13.815: silvestrī nāta sub umbrā … frāga
Hor. S. 2.2.57: corna; Verg. E. 3.70: arbor (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Of the woods, wooded; and so of plants and animals that grow wild (Lewis & Short). Columella pairs arborēs silvestrēs ac ferae.
Of the country in general, and so of wild fruit and plants; of people it is rustic, and often boorish, uncouth (see rural).

phrases.latin: ipsa tuīs manibus silvestrī nāta sub umbrā mollia frāga legēs
phrases.english: with your own hands you will pick soft strawberries grown in the shade of the woods

phrases.latin: cibī simplicēs, agrestia pōma, recēns fera aut lac concrētum
phrases.english: their food is plain: wild fruit, fresh game or curdled milk

sources: Lewis & Short: silvestris · Lewis & Short: agrestis
